transaction_behavior.record_contradiction: opens its own BEGIN IMMEDIATE via transaction()
transaction_behavior.promote_fact: opens its own transaction; promote_fact_in_transaction joins
transaction_behavior.import_extraction: opens its own transaction; import_extraction_in_transaction joins

notes: Existing contradiction domain is advisory detection plus event append; it does not expose overwrite, force, or winner-selection modes.

Apply preflight uses detect_claim_conflict inside the apply transaction. A blocking conflict raises ApplyBlockedError, rolls back authoritative writes, and records error_json/review_json in a separate staging-metadata transaction.
No --conflict-resolution CLI flag is exposed because the audit found no safe resolution mode on the existing domain API.
Importer calls domain APIs only; it does not duplicate fact or membership SQL.

adaptation: domain writers gained *_in_transaction variants so apply can compose detection, import_extraction, promote_fact, membership, and item transition in one authoritative transaction
